query: { vaultV2s(first: 1000, where: {listed: true}) { pageInfo { countTotal } items { address totalAssetsUsd chain { id } timelocks { selector duration } } } }
note: Timelock (waiting period) of each curator function of every listed Morpho Vault V2, all chains. selector 0xb192a84a = setIsAllocator(address,bool), 0x60d54d41 = addAdapter(address), 0xf6f98fd5 = increaseAbsoluteCap(bytes,uint256), 0x2438525b = increaseRelativeCap(bytes,uint256). duration is in seconds. decreaseTimelock waits as long as the timelock of the selector it shortens, so its own entry is not used.
